courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

place.name: 新加坡
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public facility/research reference, not an operating entrance or the teaching laboratory.

references.scope: 2025年3月更新的典型值、量測單位與指引欄位，用於資料判讀；典型值不是逐批操作限值。
references.scopeEn: Typical values, units and guideline columns updated March 2025, used for data literacy; typical values are not batch operating limits.

references.scope: PUB 的再生水流程概述；不同工廠前處理配置可能不同，不作自行製備飲用水的配方。
references.scopeEn: PUB overview of water reclamation. Pretreatment varies across facilities; this is not a recipe for producing drinking water independently.

place.name: 新北八里代表點
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public facility/research reference, not an operating entrance or the teaching laboratory.

courses.summary: 新北市官方資料記錄八里初沉與蛋型消化設施，並於2026年3月公布跨市管理移交；課程以此討論持續運轉的交接證據。
courses.summaryEn: New Taipei records primary settling and egg-shaped digestion facilities and announced the intermunicipal management transfer in March2026; the course uses this to discuss continuity evidence.

history.title: 八里污水處理廠
history.text: 新北市官方資料記錄八里初沉與蛋型消化設施，並於2026年3月公布跨市管理移交；課程以此討論持續運轉的交接證據。
history.textEn: New Taipei records primary settling and egg-shaped digestion facilities and announced the intermunicipal management transfer in March2026; the course uses this to discuss continuity evidence.

courses.connection: 八里課程聚焦集水、初沉、污泥消化及放流介面，並把跨市流量與設備維護紀錄納入交接；不假設初沉已去除所有溶解污染。
courses.connectionEn: Bali focuses on collection, primary settling, digestion and discharge, including intermunicipal flow and asset records; primary settling is not assumed to remove every dissolved pollutant.
